datasets.name: Landslide inventory of the study area
datasets.verbatim: In this study, an inventory dataset of the polygons of the landslides for the study area was prepared from a manual delineation of landslides based on the PlanetScope imagery.

datasets.name: PlanetScope imagery
datasets.verbatim: The satellite images are taken from the Planet Labs, Inc. PlanetScope... [Online]. Available: https://api.planet.com

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR DEM (12.5 m resolution)
datasets.verbatim: Topographical information was extracted from a DEM 12.5 m from the ALOS PALSAR sensor

methods.name: CNN model combined by the Dempster–Shafer (D–S) model
methods.summary: The method uses two CNN streams (CNNO trained on spectral data, and CNNOT trained on spectral plus topographic data) to produce landslide probability maps. These maps are then integrated using the Dempster–Shafer (D–S) model to optimize the final landslide detection result.
methods.verbatim: The applied CNN structure in this study is designed and trained in Trimble’s eCognition software based on the Google TensorFlow software library and the D–S model is done within the QGIS environment.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory is not linked, and the PlanetScope and ALOS PALSAR datasets are not accessible as they are commercial or lack clear access paths. The custom CNN and D-S model implementation code is not provided.
